read: Nah-only canonical 47-verse inventory and WEB witness

evidence_only_guard: Hebrew syntax, lexemes, parallelism, sound-play, disputed acrostic-like traces, witness pressure, translation difficulty, speaker shifts, and internal relations are boundary evidence only. They decide no preferred text, speaker, identity, date, fulfillment, ethics, canon, or theology. Roots are not meanings; context controls. Agreement is evidence, never authority.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Theophany with irregular partial alphabetic/acrostic-like traces and refuge/flood contrast.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No alphabet completion, emendation, lost-stanza reconstruction, witness preference, or doctrinal inference.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Compressed syntax, shelemim wording, and singular/plural addressee reversals.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No preferred syntax, named ruler, addressee certainty, source split, or identity.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: English 1:15 is Hebrew 2:1; good news crosses to scatterer/restoration language.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: Keep English coordinates; no chapter authority, messenger identity, fulfillment, or Isaiah direction.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Rare military terms, hutzab, pool syntax, gendered referents, and buqah-mebuqah-mebullaqah.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No weapon, proper-name, hydraulic, emendation, or preferred syntax ruling.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Battle sounds move through accusation to sexualized humiliation.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No endorsement, victim-blaming, literalization, sanitization, or ethics/theology ruling.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: No-Amon geography/allies, gam-hi/gam-att application, figs, and gendered taunt.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No conquest date, historical equivalence, or gender essentialism.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.pressure: Mid-3:15 pivot, locust vocabulary, rare tapsarayikh, royal address, wound/applause close.
textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: No species, rank, king, fulfillment, or ethical endorsement.

global_holds.witnesses: OSHB and UXLC are correlated Masoretic/Leningrad-family evidence, not independent ancient votes. MT manuscripts, Greek Twelve, Judean-desert evidence where extant, Syriac, Vulgate, Targum, and later witnesses expose pressure but establish no preferred reading.
global_holds.versification: English Nah.1.15 is normally Hebrew 2:1. Required English coordinates are retained; displacement is evidence only.
global_holds.acrostic: Nah.1.2-1.8 has partial/disputed alphabetic signals; no completion or reconstructed authority.
global_holds.speech: YHWH, prophetic voice, Judah, Nineveh, adversary, king, and city-personification shift rapidly; pronouns remain LOW.
global_holds.internal_relations: Exodus 34, sea poems, Isaiah 52, Jonah, the Twelve, and later reuse are evidence only; no direction, identity, fulfillment, theology, or seam authority.
global_holds.violence_ethics: War, corpses, sexualized humiliation, child violence, gendered taunt, and applause are literary data; chunking neither endorses nor resolves them.
global_holds.confidence_policy: Every boundary is LOW and deferred_human_or_external_ai due unresolved textual, speaker, versification, translation, rhetoric, and witness questions.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Massa Nineveh, sefer chazon, and the prophet designation form a compact nominal heading before repeated divine-name poetry.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Nominal heading syntax differs from 1:2 poetry.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Theophanic hymn of storm and cosmic dissolution
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Vengeance repetition, storm, drying, quaking, paired mi questions, fire, and rocks crescendo to inability to stand.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Reconstruct disputed alphabetic strophes or atomize images.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Repeated YHWH and cosmic acts cohere; questions climax before tov YHWH.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Tov YHWH resets evaluation; refuge is counterposed by flood, full end, and darkness.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach 1:7 or assign 1:8 to next unit.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Good/refuge versus flood/darkness is an antithetical close.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Ma-techashshevun opens challenge; kalah, second-time language, thorn/drink/stubble, and mimmeakh yatsa bind plot and plotter.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split images or merge koh-amar oracle.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Plotting lexemes enclose the unit; 1:12 resets speech.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Koh amar YHWH opens; affliction/yoke/bonds address one party, then vetsivvah YHWH alekha turns to name, images, and grave.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Force source split at 1:14 or merge 1:15.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Formal divine speech holds the larger unit while preserving address ambiguity.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hinneh al-heharim opens messenger tableau; peace leads to feast/vow imperatives and no-more passage.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Let English chapter edge decide or absorb into adjacent oracle.
proposed_chunks.risk: Single verse; Hebrew 2:1; messenger; Isaiah relation.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Hinneh, mountain messenger, and Judah vocative form a proclamation.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Scatterer taunt, defense commands, and restoration rationale
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Alah mefits announces arrival; guard/watch/strengthen/fortify imperatives are followed by ki shav YHWH.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Separate rationale or merge siege through 2:10.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Imperative cluster plus ki rationale makes a threshold before shields at 2:3.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Shield color, warriors, chariots, streets, torch/lightning similes, officer summons, wall-rush, and screen deployment complete approach.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Combat nouns accelerate toward the wall; gates at 2:6 mark breach.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Breach, collapse, flight, plunder, and desolation
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Opened river gates lead through hutzab, pool-flight, stop cries, plunder, and buqah-mebuqah-mebullaqah panic.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Isolate hutzab or join lion taunt.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Breach-to-empty-city sequence and climactic sound pattern cohere.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Ayeh opens lion/prey repetition; hineni elayikh answers with burning, sword, prey-cutting, and silenced messengers.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The oracle reuses lion/prey language and resolves the question.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hoy ir damim opens whip, wheel, horse, chariot, sword, spear, slain, corpses, and stumbling bodies in compressed lines.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Atomize sounds or merge merov accusation.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Sound/motion catalogue makes one movement; merov shifts to cause.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Merov introduces cause; prostitution/witchcraft moves to hineni elayikh, exposure, flight, waste, and mourning questions.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split accusation from sentence or literalize image.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Causal frame and sustained city address bind accusation and spectacle.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hatetvi min-No Amon opens comparison; defenses/allies are listed, then gam-hi reverses strength into exile and chains.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split geography from fall or absorb gam-att application.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Question and gam-hi answer form precedent before gam-att application.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Application through drunkenness, figs, and opened gates
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Gam-att turns to Nineveh; drunken/hidden/refuge, fig simile, hinneh, open gates, and consumed bars develop defenselessness.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Second-person application coheres; 3:14 imperatives reset rhetoric.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Water/fortress/clay/brick imperatives are answered by sham: fire and sword consume; locust-like multiplication twists preparation into doom.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 3:15 mid-verse or merge all locust imagery.
proposed_chunks.risk: Mid-verse pivot; brick terms; locust taxonomy.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Preparation and sham response are inseparable at verse granularity.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hirbeit extends multiplication to merchants; yeleq and official swarms settle, strip, fly, and vanish.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Separate merchants from officials or attach lament.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Locust lexemes and disperse motion bind both verses; 3:18 changes address.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: King-directed shepherd lament and final taunt
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Namu roekha addresses Assyria's king; sleeping leaders, scattered people, en-keihah, clapping, and final mi question close.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split collapse from wound or supply answer.
proposed_chunks.risk: King identity; sleep/death; wound; applause ethics.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Royal address leads into no-healing closure and terminal question.
